item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes and specifies the composition of an advisory council, an internal organizational action; no substantive legal consequence for outside parties occurs.","evidence":"There is hereby established the Advisory Council on Intergovernmental Personnel Policy"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The segment assigns council leadership, permits administrative compensation and expenses, and directs the council to study and recommend policies; it does not dictate a legally consequential outcome.","evidence":"The Council shall study and make recommendations on intergovernmental personnel policies and programs"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"Executive agencies must provide internal staff and information support, and the council must issue findings and recommendations; these are administrative assistance and reporting duties.","evidence":"The Civil Service Commission shall provide staff assistance to the Council"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The council must prepare a study report containing views and recommendations by a deadline, without itself changing grant conditions, standards, incentives, or legal rights.","evidence":"the Council shall submit an initial report on its activities"}]}
